source_refs.note: Topic 1.1 Introduction to Computer Networks as printed up to its first sub-heading (PDF 6-7, printed 1-2); the sub-headings are their own lessons.

blocks.text: A computer network allows different devices to connect and communicate with each other. It helps in sharing information quickly and easily. Communication through networks saves time and effort. Computer networks are used in homes, schools, offices, and businesses. Modern life depends heavily on computer networks for daily tasks.

blocks.alt: A wireless router in the centre with Wi-Fi waves, joined by dashed lines to a desktop computer, a laptop, a monitor, a printer, a mobile phone, a folder, a cloud, a music note and a video play button.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.1: A computer network connects multiple devices to share data and resources (original drawing after the textbook's Figure 1.1).

blocks.text: Networks can connect computers, mobile phones, printers, and other digital devices (as shown in Figure 1.1). These devices communicate using cables or wireless signals. A network allows data, files, and resources to move from one device to another. Networks can be small or large depending on the need.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Networks support online learning and remote work. Businesses rely on networks for daily operations.
